description: A black screen. Red letters. One small favour: move a potted plant three inches to the left. Nothing wrong, nothing against the law, and nobody gets hurt.

Jack was thirty one, lonely, and had nothing to lose. So he moved the plant. Twelve years later he had the job, the big house and a wife who laughed at his jokes, and every single one of those years had been paid for by somebody he never met.
A Scroll Kaos 3D horror story. Watch to the end, and ask yourself what you would have answered.

top: - **Story rights (important):** the source page is "The Seer of Possibilities" by Thomas O. on Creepypasta.com (26 January 2015). That site's own rules say its stories may not be narrated or performed in any form (UNVERIFIED wording, read it yourself). This video is a retelling in our own words with original animation, not a reading of the text, but **before you monetise it, write to Creepypasta.com and to the author and ask for narration permission.** Whether permission is needed, and who can give it, is UNVERIFIED.
- No famous image is copied: the Seer, Jack, Allie, Donna and the delivery boy are the channel's own 3D designs.
flags.age_restriction: - Age-restriction risk: a knife is seen in a doorway but never used on anybody, two deaths happen off screen, and a beating is only described in one short line. YouTube may still age-restrict it (UNVERIFIED).
bottom: - Non-graphic changes: nothing is shown of the wife's death or of the attack on the boy; the original's harder lines about the beating, the drugs and the robbery are kept short and are only spoken, never pictured. No blood anywhere.
- Photosensitive safety: no flashing or strobe anywhere; the screen light, the red words and the car lights are steady or fade slowly.

- Reel shortening: the Reel keeps every main beat and the twist, but drops the counsellors and the promotion, the "she was not the one for you" speech, the Seer's own history as a painter, and most of the favours, and it names fewer people.
